rule: random.Random(SEED).shuffle(IDs sorted by numeric suffix); first 13 development, remaining 10 test
decision: Owner chose 10 test / 13 development on 2026-09-21 (alternatives offered: 12/11, 8/15, hold). docs/plans/2026-09-17-friends-hill-climb-and-normalization.md:222-224 had suggested 14/9.
goldUnitDefinition: Per participant sheet, a maximal run of consecutive rows whose WhichEvent, normalized to a number, is non-blank and equal and whose RecallType is 1; any other row ends the run. Veridical recall only. Reproduces the 630 units in docs/plans/2026-09-17-friends-hill-climb-and-normalization.md:142.

sealAccounting.scope: friends_guard.seal_accounting: per-side participant and gold-unit totals, and the development median. No test participant's individual count is recorded.

power.estimand: participant-average exact accuracy difference between two mappers (paired)
power.method: two-sided one-sample t test on per-participant paired differences; noncentral t power by Simpson quadrature over the chi-square density (stdlib, this script)

mdeBySdAssumption.label: FilmFestival lexical minus ONNX, paired change per eligible unit
FilmFestival SD rescaled to Friends unit counts (assumption)
mdeBySdAssumption.source: FilmFestival SD x sqrt(median eligible units 239 / Friends development median gold units 22); assumes unit-sampling noise dominates

caveats: Friends has a median of 23 gold units per participant against hundreds per FilmFestival participant, so its per-participant accuracy is noisier; the rescaled row is the assumption closest to Friends and the others are optimistic.
The primary analysis may use a participant-cluster bootstrap rather than a t test; the t-based MDE is the planning figure, not the analysis.

priorHumanCodingStatistics: Aggregate recall-order statistics over all 23 participants: per-participant Spearman rho median 0.39 (range -0.53 to 0.98, 4 of 23 negative), within storyline median 0.90 (2 of 23 negative); 74.1% non-decreasing transitions, 81.5% within storyline, 38.2% storyline switches (docs/plans/2026-09-17-friends-hill-climb-and-normalization.md:96-105).
Individual rho values named for s6, s26 and s21 (docs/plans/2026-09-17-friends-hill-climb-and-normalization.md:107-109).

Gold-unit counts and per-event coverage over all 23: 630 units, median 23 per participant, range 4-46; per-event coverage median 11 of 23 (docs/plans/2026-09-17-friends-hill-climb-and-normalization.md:142-149).
Per-sheet recall extents and code-book counts in docs/data/friends/source-manifest.json.
